info.title: 40C3 APIv2
info.description:
This is the version 2 of the API for the 40C3 API platform.
It provides access to various resources such as conferences, events, users, and projects.

In addition to this API you can visit the [Conference](https://events.ccc.de/congress/2026/hub/en/index/) or the [backoffice](https://events.ccc.de/congress/2026/hub/backoffice/) interface of the
platform.

get.description: Get a language by its tag. Also returns languages which are not offered, but are referenced e.g. by an interpretation.
Can be used for checking if the API is online. Returns `pong`.

Returns the authenticated User and, for API tokens, the token itself.

The claims of `user` are filled for the scopes of the request:

- API token: the scopes of the token.
- OIDC access token: the scopes granted to the access token.
- Hub session: all scopes.

Claims without their scope are null:

- `openid`: `id`, a stable ID of the User for the client (not the User UUID).
- `profile`: `username`, `display_name`, `description`, `slug`, `pronouns`, `status` and `avatar`.
- `email`: `email` and `email_verified`.
- `dect`: `dect`.
- `uffd_link`: `uffd_linked`.

400.description: The request was not authenticated with an API token.

post.description: Revokes the API token of the request. Sessions and OIDC access tokens cannot be revoked here.
